description: Machine-readable privilege matrix for HimVote platform. Covers 11 principals, resources, operations, approval prerequisites, logging policy, and prohibited escalations.

trust_boundaries.identity_origin: services/identity_issuer — manages accounts, roles, credentials, rosters
trust_boundaries.casting_origin: services/casting — anonymous ballot acceptance; NEVER receives identity tokens
trust_boundaries.admin_boundary: services/admin_api — election lifecycle, manifest signing, result publication
trust_boundaries.blockchain_boundary: chain/ — immutable EVM anchor; relayer has RELAYER_ROLE only
trust_boundaries.verifier_boundary: verifier/ — fully offline; trusts only supplied external pins

principals.created_by: bootstrap_claim endpoint (one-time, token-gated, permanently disabled after use)
Invitation from SUPER_ADMIN; two-person approval required for sensitive ops
Roster import (CSV, teacher-approved) then account creation
Internal service; private RSA blind-signature key held by identity_issuer only
Internal service; accepts anonymous credentials, never receives identity tokens
Election officer registration; per ADR-003 design, trustee key ceremony documented but simulated in prototype
principals.limitation: Profile VEEM (homegrown ElGamal) does not use full threshold trustee key ceremony; single operator in prototype

principals.created_by: Separately keyed service; signing key never shared with identity/casting/admin
principals.limitation: In local Compose deployment, witness and election server share same operator — independence is SIMULATED

principals.created_by: Internal service; holds RELAYER_ROLE on HimVoteAnchor contract only
Receives exported election archive and separate trust pins; runs verifier/verify.py offline
principals.limitation: In prototype, auditor keys are demo-generated. Production requires separately owned signing key pair.

privilege_matrix.prerequisite: BOOTSTRAP_ALLOWED env=true; one-time token; no prior super_admin in DB
privilege_matrix.prohibited_escalation: Cannot be called again after bootstrap_claimed=true in system_settings

privilege_matrix.prerequisite: Authenticated session; invitation token hashed SHA-256; expires in INVITATION_EXPIRE_DAYS
Approval required from second admin (cannot self-approve); ApprovalRequest model
privilege_matrix.prohibited_escalation: Creator cannot approve their own request (checked in approval endpoint)

privilege_matrix.prerequisite: Election in DRAFT or REVIEW state; CSV validated for duplicates and format errors
privilege_matrix.prohibited_escalation: STUDENT cannot import roster; TEACHER scope limited to own department
TEACHER cannot approve their own submitted roster (two-role separation encouraged)

allowed: CREDENTIAL_ISSUER service (on behalf of authenticated STUDENT)
privilege_matrix.prerequisite: Student in approved roster; election in ISSUING state; not previously issued
privilege_matrix.prohibited_escalation: No admin can request credential issuance for another student; issuance is idempotent per student-election pair

privilege_matrix.prerequisite: State=APPROVED; manifest, candidates, roster, keys committed
State=SCHEDULED or FROZEN; manifest_digest pinned; roster frozen
Anonymous credential proof valid; election OPEN; nullifier not spent; no Authorization/Cookie headers
privilege_matrix.logging: Leaf index and nullifier commitment only (no choice logged)
privilege_matrix.prohibited_escalation: Identity headers strictly rejected by CastingOriginSecurityMiddleware

privilege_matrix.prerequisite: State=AUDIT_PASSED or AUDITOR_ATTESTED; tally proof verified; witness signed final checkpoint
privilege_matrix.prohibited_escalation: Cannot publish without witness signature and proof verification

privilege_matrix.prerequisite: Election in CLOSED or later state
privilege_matrix.prohibited_escalation: Archive contains no plaintext votes or identity-ballot links

privilege_matrix.prerequisite: Monotonic sequence; non-zero digest; matching previous digest
privilege_matrix.prohibited_escalation: Only RELAYER_ROLE can anchor; finalized elections cannot be re-anchored

privilege_matrix.prerequisite: Sequential leaf validation; monotonic tree size; prior checkpoint continuity
privilege_matrix.prohibited_escalation: Witness private key must NOT be accessible to election server admin

prohibited_escalations_summary: No ADMINISTRATOR role inherits TRUSTEE decryption shares or WITNESS signing key
No ADMINISTRATOR can access casting origin or read ballot choices
STUDENT cannot import rosters, create elections, or issue credentials
TEACHER scope is department-limited; cannot approve their own roster submissions
CREDENTIAL_ISSUER key is not accessible to ADMINISTRATOR or ELECTION_OFFICER
BLOCKCHAIN_RELAYER holds only RELAYER_ROLE — cannot modify contract admin
INDEPENDENT_AUDITOR verifies from separate, externally supplied trust pins — cannot modify results
independence_limitations: In local docker-compose deployment, WITNESS and BLOCKCHAIN_RELAYER share the same host operator — independence is SIMULATED
For real independence, WITNESS must be operated by a separate institution with air-gapped key management
Profile VEEM trustee key ceremony is simulated; full threshold decryption with M-of-N trustees requires production deployment
INDEPENDENT_AUDITOR role is exercised offline via verifier/verify.py with externally pinned keys
